acceptedAnswer.text: Black Friday is on 27 November 2026, the day after US Thanksgiving. Cyber Monday is on 30 November.

mainEntity.name: Are Black Friday web hosting deals worth it?

acceptedAnswer.text: They can be, if you can accept the term and the renewal price. Check the price you will pay after the first term, and the money-back window.

mainEntity.name: Do Black Friday hosting prices apply when I renew?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually not. The sale price covers the first term. The host's page shows the renewal price, which is often several times higher.

mainEntity.name: Can I use a Black Friday deal on a host I already use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often not. Kinsta limits its offer to new customers, and ScalaHosting limits its offer to new plans and upgrades.

mainEntity.name: Which host has the lowest Black Friday price?

acceptedAnswer.text: hosting.com lists the lowest sale prices here, from $1.49 a month on a 12-month plan, but it also has the biggest renewal jump.

mainEntity.name: Which of these hosts list AI features?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hostinger, hosting.com, Cloudways, ScalaHosting and Spaceship list AI features on their pages. We have not tested them.

mainEntity.name: How long do Black Friday hosting deals last?

acceptedAnswer.text: It varies. In the pages we read, offers ended on 1 December (ScalaHosting, Kinsta) or 14 December (Hostinger, hosting.com). Cloudways showed no end date.
